name: dai-cg-priv2
command: exec > /out/cg-priv2.txt 2>&1; echo '== /proc/self/cgroup =='; cat /proc/self/cgroup; echo; echo '== mkdir scope =='; mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1 && echo MKDIR_OK; ls -la /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1/ | head -6; echo; echo '== subtree_control write =='; printf '+cpu +memory +pids\n' > /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1/cgroup.subtree_control; echo "rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1/cgroup.subtree_control; echo; echo '== child move =='; sleep 120 & SP=$!; sleep 1; echo $SP > /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1/cgroup.procs; echo "move rc=$?"; echo 'procs:'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1/cgroup.procs; echo; echo '== limits write =='; echo max > /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1/memory.max 2>&1; echo "mem rc=$?"; kill $SP 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '== cleanup =='; rmdir /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-s1 2>&1 && echo RMDIR_OK || echo RMDIR_FAIL; echo done
